summary: Core facts match the verified current facts (coach, roster moves, 52-30, Lakers loss, Cup Group A, MLK slot, no Christmas game) and the long-established history (Hakeem, Clutch City, DJ Screw, Comets) holds up. The real errors were era mix-ups: the fanbase dossier put ketchup and mustard in the Yao/McGrady years and the uniform dossier gave the 1995-2003 redesign the title years; also a fabricated Truth BBQ pitmaster (Leonard Botello IV is correct), a Screwed Up Records neighborhood slip (South Park), a misattributed chef role and several small labels, all fixed in place. Remaining risk is small-business status, Johnny Dang location, Foot Locker/Champs doors, event dates, and the unconfirmed City Edition and MLK home team; the brief overstates the rodeo road trip and assumes a Candy Paint City Edition that can only apply to 2027-28.
